title: Stream a video room to RTMP
alias: RTMP live streaming of video rooms
summary: Start, update, or stop a video room's RTMP stream through REST using your streaming server URL.
scenario: A workshop stand-up on video that a wider audience watches on a streaming platform

evidence: tools/openapi/rest.json POST /api/video/rooms/{id}/streams: url required, RTMP or RTMPS; 201 id, url, stream_type
tools/openapi/rest.json PUT /api/video/streams/{id}: url required; DELETE 204; GET rooms/{id}/streams
sdk rest/namespaces/video.py: rooms.create_stream, rooms.list_streams, streams.update, streams.delete
